items.title: MECH-163 hierarchical-vs-flat falsifier + Q-085 committed-macro grain dose-response (chunk_max_size 2/3/5) on post-devaluation persistence
items.note: MECH-163 hierarchical-vs-flat falsifier AND the Q-085 grain dose-response in ONE run -- deliberate, per Q-085 what_would_answer: the statistic that discriminates the two MECH-163 architectures IS the dose-response, so the Q-085 arm costs ZERO extra compute. Do NOT queue a separate Q-085 experiment. Design taken verbatim from claims.yaml Q-085 + evidence/planning/claim_synthesis_MECH-163_2026-07-27.md sec 4b/4c; not re-derived. ARMS (6): A_OFF (both off, devaluation-response baseline, minted reuse-eligible); A_FLAT (use_dualsystem_arbitration ON, chunking OFF); A_HIER_S2/S3/S5 (use_policy_chunking + use_chunk_proposal_injection ON, arbitration OFF, chunk_max_size 2/3/5 = the dose axis); A_FLATCHUNK_S5 (arbitration ON *with* chunking, so the dose axis is not confounded with the arm). DV: post-devaluation policy persistence (resource-approach rate), reported RAW and under BOTH pre-registered confounds. GATES (a)-(d) all carried as regime-conditioned preconditions via _lib/precondition_gate (applies_to scopes the accumulator gates out of the chunking-OFF arms rather than failing them -- the V3-EXQ-785 rule; one red arm cannot vacate a green one). (a) committed arc071_chunk trajectories > 0 per seed, ZERO is a READINESS FAILURE that scores nothing, not a null -- kept STRICT because Jin & Costa 2010 establishes sequence boundaries as a property of a CONSOLIDATED sequence, which is exactly what V3-EXQ-810 lacked on seeds 202/303. (b) REALISED mean committed length must DIFFER across doses; configuring chunk_max_size is not the manipulation (an inert axis is a readiness failure, and C1 is marked non-degenerate=False when the axis is inert). (c) devaluation manipulation check measured POLICY-INDEPENDENTLY: benefit actually DELIVERED per resource contact, pre-devaluation floor AND post-devaluation ceiling, so a null DV cannot be a devaluation failure in disguise. (d) every input to the DV's own statistic gated -- its denominator (post_deval_steps) and its numerator baseline (pre_deval_approach_rate, the SAME statistic the DV routes on, not a magnitude proxy: the V3-EXQ-643 rule). TWO OPPOSED CONFOUNDS, both logged, both reported SEPARATELY -- reporting only one cannot disambiguate them. (1) INTERRUPTION (registered in claims.yaml): a longer macro meets MORE mid-commitment release opportunities so it can read as LESS insensitive; reported as persistence_uninterrupted. All four optional releases (MECH-342, rung-6 natural-commit/SD-033e, MECH-321/ARC-070, SD-034) are PINNED OFF, leaving MECH-091 as the only live release, so an interrupted macro has exactly one possible cause. (2) DEVALUATION KNOWABILITY (NEW 2026-07-29, from the Ostlund/Winterbauer/Balleine 2009 entry in evidence/literature/targeted_review_q_085/, mixed 0.72): Ostlund's shams were NOT made outcome-insensitive by chunking -- sensitivity RELOCATED to the sequence boundary, and they withheld the WHOLE devalued sequence. So persistence rises with realised length ONLY insofar as the value change becomes knowable AFTER the beta gate commits; if it is knowable at chunk onset the agent simply declines to commit and the run returns a FLAT dose-response WHILE THE HYPOTHESIS IS TRUE (a false RESOLVED-NO). Every committed chunk therefore records its commit tick relative to the tick the devaluation first became KNOWABLE -- defined as the agent's first post-devaluation resource CONTACT, since flipping the value does not inform the agent, experiencing it does -- and persistence is reported conditioned on chunks committed BEFORE that tick (persistence_pre_knowable, which is what C1 routes on). Episodes that never make it knowable are their own bucket, not folded in. READINESS INHERITED, NOT RE-DERIVED: every env/schedule/chunking constant comes from experiments/_lib/baselines/arc071_chunking.py, the canonical lineage module whose config PASSED V3-EXQ-810a (chunk_accumulator_fires, 2026-07-28, 8 seeds, 120ep x 72step, num_hazards=2, alpha_world=0.9). This SATISFIES the claim_synthesis secondary gate 'should not be queued until 810's successor clears'. The schedule is NOT negotiable downward: V3-EXQ-834 shortened it to 100ep x 60step and formed ZERO chunks in all five arms after 7.3h (substrate_not_ready_requeue) with its symbol buffer nonetheless clearing 7.5 -- so buffer adequacy does not imply formation. DEVIATION, stated so no reader has to infer it (also in the manifest under devaluation_route): claims.yaml names the SD-033b OFC-analog devaluation head. That route produces ZERO bias until TRAINED (ofc_train_devaluation_head=False zeroes the last Linear), so it needs per-cell gradient training, and V3-EXQ-810a measured gradient mode at ~2 s/step in this env -- putting a 6x8 grid at ~28h against ~10h no-grad, with the formation schedule unable to absorb the difference (see 834). Devaluation is therefore a DIRECT outcome devaluation (env.resource_benefit -> 0 mid-episode), which is the Balleine manipulation the OFC head was standing in for; gate (c) is policy-independent either way. Note the 485 lineage's own status supports this being sufficient: 485m's C1_devaluation_behavioural_shift PASSED non-degenerately with all six preconditions met -- its conversion ceiling is on the DISCRIMINATION signature (C2/C1b), not on the devaluation shift Q-085 needs. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is persistence-vs-realised-committed-length under devaluation. Checked every manifest carrying chunk_max_size (only 810a + 834, both substrate_hash 12dc9bfd..., both ARC-071/MECH-323 readiness probes with NO devaluation phase and no persistence readout) and the whole 485 devaluation lineage (485g/i/k/m -- devaluation but no chunking arm, no dose axis). The joint readout exists in no recorded run and is not derivable post-hoc -> run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: counted 0 for MECH-163 and Q-085, 1 for MECH-323/ARC-071 (threshold 2) -- does not fire. Not a lettered iteration of 810/834: different claims, different DV, different question. SEQUENCING TRAP (claims.yaml, do not violate): building a value-driven mid-commitment release would DESTROY the phenomenon under test and must come AFTER this question is answered. The pin is asserted in-script. claim_ids are MECH-163 + Q-085 ONLY. ARC-071/MECH-323 are EXERCISED as preconditions but not tested, and tagging them would inflate their records with a run that cannot move them (the peripheral-co-tag inflation the brake's per-claim override exists to undo); Q-085's own note also states that registering the controllability semantics against MECH-323 would hide the coupling. Smoke: PASS (--dry-run, 6 arms x 2 seeds end-to-end, self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue as it must at 2 episodes). validate_experiments.py --strict --paths: 1 OK, 0 warnings across all 20 checks.

items.title: MECH-217 offline wanting-spread substrate readiness (EVB-0349)
items.note: Substrate readiness diagnostic for MECH-217 (EXP-0301 / EVB-0349), immediately following the 2026-07-30 implementation landing (HippocampalConfig.use_offline_wanting_spread, offline_wanting_spread_gamma/gain; HippocampalModule.spread_reverse_replay_wanting() called from REEAgent.run_rem_attribution_pass() on the SD-017 REM pass). 2-arm (ARM_OFF/ARM_ON) x 3-seed ablation, scripted greedy-toward-resource walk (privileged, isolates the spread mechanism from the agent's own navigation policy), terminus wanting seeded directly (isolates from MECH-203, unused here). Measures near-vs-far-vs-off-path-control VALENCE_WANTING after N_CYCLES wake-sleep cycles. GOV-REUSE-1: brand-new substrate just landed; no existing manifest could carry this readout -> not recoverable, run. Not braked (zero prior autopsies on MECH-217). Not the full behavioural navigation-lift claim (a follow-up EXQ once this PASSes). Smoke: --dry-run PASS (1 seed, 2 cycles); full 6-cell run (3 seeds x 2 arms) also verified PASS locally before queuing (manifest not kept -- queued run is the recorded evidence). validate_experiments.py --strict OK (0 warnings).

items.title: ARC-071/MECH-323 seed-202 narrow-repertoire diagnostic (V3-EXQ-810a residual, /failure-autopsy 2026-07-30)
items.note: Targeted follow-up on a specific residual flagged by the confirmed /failure-autopsy for V3-EXQ-810a (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-810a_2026-07-30, C1 7/8 seeds=0.875 vs 0.75 bar): in ARM_FULL, seed 202 formed ZERO chunks despite readiness preconditions holding at wide margin (episode_outcome_spread 0.3488 = 7.0x floor, harm_step_fraction 0.0267 = 2.7x floor) -- worst cell on both, still comfortably clear. Not load-bearing against the aggregate PASS; user-selected routing was 'confirm but flag seed-202 for a future targeted probe'. THE PUZZLE: re-reading 810a's own manifest, seed 202 and seed 303 have IDENTICAL chunk_acc_n_tracked_sequences (18) yet 202 formed 0 and 303 formed 6 -- so the residual is NOT a smaller tracked-sequence repertoire. Two live hypotheses discriminated by new instrumentation, neither a substrate build: H1 (narrow repertoire, 810's own precedent -- its autopsy found 43/120 and 37/120 episodes were a SINGLE HELD action on its silent seeds vs 16/120 on the forming one) tested via a new single_held_action_episode_fraction readout (per-episode snapshot of accumulator._episode_actions taken before note_chunk_outcome each episode, before end_episode() clears it next episode). H2 (per-sequence gate failure -- reps/variance/outcome-margin, ChunkAccumulator.formation_candidates()'s own three-way test) tested via a new final-state per-tracked-sequence breakdown reading accumulator._tally + ._outcome_history (private state the substrate itself already reads internally at policy_chunking.py:1795/1888/1951/1971 for its own diagnostics -- read-only here, no substrate modification). Single arm (ARM_FULL only) at 810a's EXACT config (72 steps x 120 episodes, full agent loop, num_hazards=2, all-position credit), 3-seed subset: 202 (target), 303 (matched-repertoire former, tightest contrast), 606 (strongest former, context). Built from experiments/_lib/baselines/arc071_chunking.py (build_env/build_agent/off_arm_flags, the lineage's canonical module -- its own docstring already names this succession '810a -> 810b -> ...'), so bit-for-bit reproducible against 810a's own ARM_FULL rows for these 3 seeds (C_repro, a plumbing sanity check on this run's own integrity, not the finding). experiment_purpose=diagnostic (NOT governance evidence, matching 810a's own framing); evidence_direction=non_contributory unconditionally for both claim_ids -- this characterises a residual on an already-PASSED readiness claim and does not itself move confidence. D1 (informational only): seed 202's single_held_action_episode_fraction exceeds max(303,606)'s by >= 0.10 (pre-registered margin, conservative vs 810's own ~0.2-0.225 gap) -> narrow_repertoire_confirmed; else narrow_repertoire_not_supported (routes to the per-sequence H2 breakdown as the informative readout instead). GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readouts are single_held_action_episode_fraction and the per-sequence gate breakdown; checked both 810a and the original 810 manifest -- neither records a per-episode action stream or a per-sequence tally (only per-cell aggregate counts) -> not recoverable, run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): zero substrate_ceiling autopsies counted for ARC-071/MECH-323 (the four autopsies tagging them read standard/mixed/measurement_test_design_defect/non_contributory-competence_implementation_gap, none substrate_ceiling) -> not braked. DV-SYMMETRY: not applicable in the 604c/643 sense -- this run's DVs (single_held_action_episode_fraction, per-sequence reps/variance/mean) are direct counts/statistics over the raw committed-action and outcome streams, not derived from an argmax/order-statistic over candidates, and the manipulation under study is a pre-existing seed-vs-seed behavioural difference, not an added scalar/rescaling/permutation on this run's own arm. Smoke: --dry-run PASS (1 seed x 4 episodes, harness+instrumentation execute end to end; FAIL/reproducibility_mismatch_investigate outcome in the smoke itself is EXPECTED and correct, since a 4-episode toy run cannot reproduce 810a's 120-episode rows -- not a bug). validate_experiments.py --strict --paths: 1 OK, 0 warnings across all 20 checks.
